coupling_convention: tensor-to-scalar ratio r (dimensionless, y-axis) vs scalar spectral index n_s (dimensionless, x-axis); NOT a mass-coupling plane
notes: This is a theoretical model-building paper (SMASH: SM + Axion + Seesaw + Higgs portal inflation). It predicts an axion dark matter mass window of 50-200 ueV (f_A between 3e10 and 1.2e11 GeV) but does not present any new experimental exclusion limit or sensitivity projection on a coupling. The mass window is a theory prediction/target region to be probed by future experiments (MADMAX, ORPHEUS), not an exclusion bound.
